latinEntries.meaning: to knot, to tie in knots

definition_zh: 知道；了解；认识；懂得；精通
definition_en: to have information or understanding in the mind, to be familiar with a person or place, or to have learned a skill well
core_image: 一个人忽然点头，脑中的疑问合上了口
scene: 雨夜的车站，两个陌生人挤在同一个屋檐下。I know the timetable by heart, so I told her which platform to wait on.
sceneCN: 这里 know 是「知道、了解」（第 1 个义项：头脑中掌握信息或事实），句意是我把时刻表记得很熟，于是告诉她该在哪个月台等。画面里有雨夜车站与同挤屋檐下的两个人。

pos.zh: 动词：知道；了解；认识；懂得；精通

derivatives.zh: 由 know 加名词后缀构成，义为「知识；了解」
过去分词转形容词，义为「已知的；知名的」
un- 与 known 合成，义为「未知的；不出名的」
加 -ing 与 -ly 构成，义为「故意地、明知地」

senses.title: To have information in mind
senses.definition: to have a fact, a piece of information, or an answer in your mind
senses.definitionCN: 脑中掌握某个事实、信息或答案
senses.example: Do you know where the nearest chemist is?
senses.exampleCN: 你知道最近的药店在哪里吗？
senses.why: The core sense is having something present in the mind, as opposed to guessing or looking it up.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是心中已有某事，相对于猜测或临时去查。

senses.title: To be familiar with a person or place
senses.definition: to have met a person, or to be familiar with a place
senses.definitionCN: 见过某人，或对某地很熟悉
senses.example: I have known her since we were children.
senses.exampleCN: 我从孩提时代就认识她。
senses.why: Familiarity is information gained by repeated contact, so the same verb covers people and places.
senses.whyCN: 熟悉是靠反复接触得来的信息，所以同一个动词兼指人与地方。

senses.title: To understand or be able to do
senses.definition: to understand a subject or to be able to do something through learning
senses.definitionCN: 因学习而理解某门学问或会做某事
senses.example: She knows three languages and plays the violin.
senses.exampleCN: 她懂三种语言，还会拉小提琴。
senses.why: Knowledge learned becomes ability, so knowing shades into being skilled.
senses.whyCN: 学到的知识化为能力，于是「知道」渐渐过渡为「会」。

senses.title: To recognise or identify
senses.definition: to be able to recognise someone or something when you see or hear them
senses.definitionCN: 看见或听见时能认出来
senses.example: I knew his step on the stairs before he reached the door.
senses.exampleCN: 还没到门口，我就听出他在楼梯上的脚步声。
senses.why: Recognition is a kind of knowledge applied at the moment of contact.
senses.whyCN: 认出是知识在接触的一瞬间被调用。

senses.title: To experience or have seen
senses.definition: to have experienced something, especially in the phrase to have known better days
senses.definitionCN: 经历过某事，尤用于 have known better days 一类说法
senses.example: This old house has known happier times.
senses.exampleCN: 这座老房子也曾有过更热闹的日子。
senses.why: To have known something is to have lived through it, which lets the verb extend to experiences.
senses.whyCN: 曾知道某事物即曾亲历它，这使这个词可以扩展到经历。

intro.en: Know goes back to a Proto-Indo-European root for knowing, and it is one of the oldest words English has.
intro.cn: know 可上溯到印欧语中表示「知道」的词根，是英语最古老的词之一。

items.en: The verb cnawan meant to know or recognise, and the k was still pronounced.
items.cn: 动词 cnawan 意为知道、认出，那时 k 仍发音。

items.en: German kennen and Dutch kennen keep the same sense in the modern languages.
items.cn: 德语 kennen 与荷兰语 kennen 在现代语言里保持同样意思。

items.en: The Greek verb gignoskein is a distant cousin, and the English suffix -gnosis in diagnosis belongs here.
items.cn: 希腊语动词 gignoskein 是远亲，诊断一词里的 -gnosis 亦出此源。

items.en: The past forms knew and known settle, and the k at the start falls silent.
items.cn: 过去式 knew 与过去分词 known 定形，词首 k 不再发音。

items.en: The noun knowledge grows beside the verb, and phrases such as as far as I know fix its uses.
items.cn: 名词 knowledge 在动词旁成长，as far as I know 等说法固定了用法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers close spellings and forms of the same family; the near-meaning group gathers other ways of holding information.
note.cn: 形近组收相近拼写与同族形式；近义组收其他掌握信息的说法。

entries.definition: The past tense form, with the silent k and the silent w.
entries.definitionCN: 过去式，k 与 w 都不发音。

entries.definition: The past participle, with the silent k kept in writing.
entries.definitionCN: 过去分词，书写中保留了不发音的 k。

entries.definition: Sounds the same for many speakers, but it is the word of refusal.
entries.definitionCN: 许多人口中读音相同，但那是表示拒绝的词。

entries.definition: To grasp how something works or what it means, deeper than having the fact.
entries.definitionCN: 弄懂某事物如何运作或含义，比只知道事实更深。

entries.definition: To identify something already met, one narrow use of knowing.
entries.definitionCN: 辨认出曾见过之物，是「知道」的一种窄用法。

entries.definition: To gain knowledge that one did not have, the step before knowing.
entries.definitionCN: 获得原先没有的知识，是「知道」之前的一步。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real root history, the irregular past forms, and the phrases the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用真实的词根历史、不规则过去式，以及这个词常见的搭配。

normal.en: Knew and known keep the silent k in writing but drop the sound.
normal.cn: knew 与 known 书写保留 k，读音却舍弃。

normal.en: The same root gives knowledge, and the Greek cousin gives diagnosis.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 knowledge，希腊语远亲给出 diagnosis。

normal.en: Know about is general information; know somebody is personal acquaintance.
normal.cn: know about 是一般信息，know somebody 是个人相识。

normal.en: Know how to names a skill rather than a fact.
normal.cn: know how to 说的是技能，不是事实。

normal.en: As far as I know is the standard hedge in English conversation.
normal.cn: as far as I know 是英语对话里标准的留有余地的说法。

abstract.en: To know is to have the world already mapped a little inside, before questions arrive.
abstract.cn: 知道就是在问题到来之前，世界已在心里稍稍画好了一张图。

abstract.en: The word covers fact, person, skill and memory because all four are held in the same place.
abstract.cn: 这个词兼指事实、人物、技能与记忆，因为四者都放在同一处。

abstract.en: Learning fills the map, but knowing is what lets a person act without checking.
abstract.cn: 学习在图上补线，而知道则让人不必查看就能行动。

examples.en: Nobody knew the answer to that question.
examples.cn: 没人知道那个问题的答案。

examples.en: She knows this neighbourhood better than I do.
examples.cn: 她比我更熟悉这一带。

examples.en: He knows how to keep a secret.
examples.cn: 他知道怎么守住秘密。

root: 古英语 cnawan「知道、认出」，源自共同日耳曼语，上溯印欧语表「知」的词根，同源于德语 kennen、希腊语 gignoskein；中古英语词首 k 静音，过去式 knew、过去分词 known 沿用至今。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: holding a fact, being familiar with people or places, having a skill, recognising, and having lived through something.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：掌握事实，熟悉人或地方，具备技能，认得出，以及亲历某事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something inside the mind is already in place before it is needed.
core.cn: 核心意象：需要之前，心里的某样东西已经就位。

branches.en: THE FACT LINE: information is held ready in the mind.
branches.cn: 事实线：信息在心里备好。

branches.en: THE FAMILIAR LINE: contact over time makes a person or place known.
branches.cn: 熟悉线：长期接触让人或地方变得「知道」。

branches.en: THE SKILL LINE: knowledge practised becomes ability.
branches.cn: 技能线：练过的知识成为能力。

branches.en: THE SENSE LINE: recognition applies stored knowledge to the present.
branches.cn: 感知线：认出是把储存的知识用于当下。

branches.en: THE LIFE LINE: what a person has lived through is also known.
branches.cn: 人生线：人亲历过的东西同样是「已知」的。

intro.en: Know is an inherited verb whose family grows through the noun knowledge and through prefixes and suffixes.
intro.cn: know 是继承而来的动词，其词族靠名词 knowledge 以及前缀、后缀扩展。

latinIntro.en: Know has a Germanic root, though the Greek branch below shares the same Indo-European origin.
latinIntro.cn: know 有日耳曼词根，下面希腊语一支也出自同一印欧语源。

items.example: A knowing smile crossed her face.
items.exampleCN: 她脸上露出心领神会的笑。
它把 know 变成 knowledge。

definition_en: the information and understanding that a person has gained through learning or experience, or the state of being aware of something
core_image: 书架一排排立起，书脊连成一片灰色的墙
scene: 图书馆的顶层几乎无人，只有翻页的轻响。Her knowledge of local history came mostly from old maps kept in the drawer.
sceneCN: 这里 knowledge 是「知识、学问」（第 1 个义项：通过学习积累的信息与理解），句意是她对本地历史的了解主要来自放在抽屉里的旧地图。画面里有安静的图书馆顶层与成排书脊。

pos.zh: 名词：知识；学问；了解；知晓（不可数）

derivatives.zh: 加 -able 构成，义为「博学的、有见识的」
由 know 加后缀构成，义为「故意地」
knowledge 的动词源头，义为「知道」
un- 与 knowledgeable 合成，义为「无知的、缺乏了解的」

senses.title: Information gained by learning
senses.definition: the facts, ideas, and skills that a person has learned over time
senses.definitionCN: 一个人长期学习积累的事实、观念与技能
senses.example: Her knowledge of chemistry is far beyond her years.
senses.exampleCN: 她的化学知识远超她的年龄。
senses.why: The noun gathers everything a person has learned into one store, the way a library holds books.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词把一个人学到的一切汇成一座仓库，正如图书馆藏书。

senses.title: Understanding of a particular field
senses.definition: familiarity with a particular subject, gained by study or work
senses.definitionCN: 因学习或工作而对某一领域产生的熟悉
senses.example: He has a working knowledge of two programming languages.
senses.exampleCN: 他能实际使用两门编程语言。
senses.why: Knowledge is often counted by field, so people speak of a working knowledge of a subject.
senses.whyCN: 知识常按领域来计算，所以人们说对某学科有「够用的了解」。

senses.title: Being aware of a fact
senses.definition: the state of knowing about something, especially something private or official
senses.definitionCN: 知道某事的状态，尤指私事或正式事务
senses.example: The letter was sent without my knowledge.
senses.exampleCN: 那封信是在我不知情的情况下寄出的。
senses.why: This sense is not learning but awareness, the fact of being informed at a given moment.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项不是学问而是知情，指在某一刻被告知的事实。

senses.title: Common or shared information
senses.definition: the information that most people in a group or a society have
senses.definitionCN: 某一群体或社会里多数人掌握的信息
senses.example: It is common knowledge that the shop closes on Mondays.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店星期一关门是众所周知的事。
senses.why: When the same facts spread through a group, the noun widens from one mind to a whole community.
senses.whyCN: 当同样的事实传遍一个群体，这个词就由一颗心扩展到整个共同体的范围。

intro.en: Knowledge was formed inside English from the verb know plus a suffix, so it has no Latin ancestry of its own.
intro.cn: knowledge 是英语内部由动词 know 加后缀构成的词，本身没有拉丁语血统。

items.en: The form knowlechen first meant to acknowledge, with the noun knowleching beside it.
items.cn: 中古英语形式 knowlechen 最初意为「承认」，旁边有名词 knowleching。

items.en: A shortened noun knowlege appears in the fourteenth century with the modern sense.
items.cn: 十四世纪出现缩短的名词 knowlege，已带现代的意义。

items.en: The root behind know is shared with German kennen, so the family is Germanic rather than Latin.
items.cn: know 的词根与德语 kennen 共享，所以这个词族属日耳曼语而非拉丁语。

items.en: The suffix -ledge lost its force, so knowledge no longer looks like a derived word.
items.cn: 后缀 -ledge 失去了构词作用，knowledge 不再像派生词。

items.en: Phrases such as to my knowledge and common knowledge fix the awareness sense.
items.cn: to my knowledge 与 common knowledge 等说法固定了「知情」这一义项。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers derived forms and neighbours of the word; the near-meaning group gathers other names for what is learned.
note.cn: 形近组收本词的派生形式与近邻词；近义组收其他指「所学之物」的词。

entries.definition: The adjective from this noun, meaning well informed.
entries.definitionCN: 由本名词派生的形容词，义为「见多识广的」。

entries.definition: A verb from the same source, meaning to admit or to confirm receipt.
entries.definitionCN: 同源动词，义为「承认、确认收到」。

entries.definition: A modern compound describing an industry built on information.
entries.definitionCN: 现代合成词，描述以信息为基础的产业。

entries.definition: Facts supplied or received, not yet organised into understanding.
entries.definitionCN: 被提供或获得的事实，尚未组织成理解。

entries.definition: The ability to judge well, grown from knowledge and experience.
entries.definitionCN: 由知识与经验长成的良好判断力。

entries.definition: Knowledge gained by formal study, especially in the humanities.
entries.definitionCN: 尤其在人文学科中通过正式学习获得的知识。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real English formation, the uncountable grammar and the phrases the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用真实的英语构词、不可数用法，以及这个词常见的搭配。

normal.en: Knowledge is built from know plus a suffix that no longer works on its own.
normal.cn: knowledge 由 know 加一个如今已不能独立使用的后缀构成。

normal.en: It is uncountable: a piece of knowledge, not a knowledge.
normal.cn: 它不可数：说 a piece of knowledge，不说 a knowledge。

normal.en: To my knowledge is the standard way of saying as far as I am informed.
normal.cn: to my knowledge 是「据我所知」的标准说法。

normal.en: Acknowledge is the same word family, with a prefix that means towards.
normal.cn: acknowledge 属同一词族，前缀表示「朝向」。

normal.en: Working knowledge means enough to use it, not enough to teach it.
normal.cn: working knowledge 指够用，而非足以教人。

abstract.en: Knowledge is a store rather than a possession: it grows when shared and shrinks when unused.
abstract.cn: 知识是仓库而不是财物：分享时变多，搁置时变少。

abstract.en: The word began as an act of admitting something, which is a reminder that knowing often starts with saying yes to a fact.
abstract.cn: 这个词最初指「承认」某事，这提醒我们：知道往往始于对一个事实说「是」。

abstract.en: To be without knowledge of a thing is not the same as to be ignorant of it; the first is simply not being told.
abstract.cn: 「不知情」与「无知」并不相同：前者只是没人告知。

examples.en: His knowledge of birds surprised the whole class.
examples.cn: 他对鸟类的知识让全班惊讶。

examples.en: To my knowledge, no one has applied for the post.
examples.cn: 据我所知，还没有人申请这个职位。

examples.en: The files were copied without her knowledge.
examples.cn: 这些文件是在她不知情的情况下被复制的。

dict_mnemonic.text: know 知道 + -ledge——知道的东西堆成一座库，就是知识

root: 中古英语 knowlechen「承认」之名 knowleching 缩短而来，由动词 know 加后缀 -ledge 构成，词根与德语 kennen 同源；十四世纪起表「知识、学问」，后又引申出「知晓、知情」义。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: the store of what has been learned, mastery of one field, the state of being informed, and facts shared by a group.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：所学之物的总和，对某一领域的掌握，知情状态，以及群体共有的常识。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rows of books on shelves, everything learned standing in its place.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排排书立在架上，学到的一切各在其位。

branches.en: THE STORE LINE: everything learned is gathered into one noun.
branches.cn: 仓库线：学到的一切被收进一个名词。

branches.en: THE FIELD LINE: knowledge is often counted by subject or by job.
branches.cn: 领域线：知识常按学科或职业来计。

branches.en: THE AWARENESS LINE: to be in the knowledge is simply to have been told.
branches.cn: 知情线：处在 the knowledge 中，就是被告知过。

branches.en: THE SHARED LINE: common knowledge belongs to a whole group.
branches.cn: 共享线：common knowledge 属于整个群体。

branches.en: THE FORM LINE: the word was made inside English from know.
branches.cn: 形式线：这个词是在英语内部由 know 造出的。

intro.en: Knowledge is an English-made noun: a native verb plus a suffix that has lost its independent meaning.
intro.cn: knowledge 是英语自造的名词：本族动词加一个已失去独立意义的后缀。

latinIntro.en: The word itself is Germanic, but the Latin words below belong to the same ancient knowing root.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词本身是日耳曼语，但下面这些拉丁词属于同一古老的「知」词根。

items.meaningCN: 构成抽象名词，现已固化
items.exampleCN: 它把 know 变成 knowledge。

items.example: It forms the older form knowledge.
items.exampleCN: 它构成较早的形式 knowledge。

definition_en: a room or building with special equipment where scientific work and tests are carried out
core_image: 一排白瓷台面，玻璃器皿与滴管安静地立着
scene: 深夜的走廊只亮着一盏应急灯。The lab on the third floor was still busy, with two students checking samples under the lamp.
sceneCN: 这里 lab 是「实验室」（第 1 个义项：配备专门设备做科学实验的房间），句意是三楼实验室仍然忙碌，两个学生在灯下检查样本。画面里有深夜走廊、应急灯与白瓷台面。

pos.zh: 名词：实验室；实验课；实验工作

derivatives.zh: lab 的完整形式，义为「实验室」
lab 与 based 合成，义为「以实验室为基础的」
lab 与 coat 合成，义为「实验服」

senses.title: A room for scientific work
senses.definition: a room or building fitted with instruments where experiments and tests are done
senses.definitionCN: 配有仪器、进行实验与检测的房间或建筑
senses.example: The samples were sent to the lab for analysis.
senses.exampleCN: 样本被送到实验室分析。
senses.why: The word is a cut-down form of laboratory, and short words suit the busy informal speech of the bench.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 laboratory 的截短形式，而简短的词正合实验台旁的日常口语。

senses.title: A practical class
senses.definition: a period of teaching in which students do practical work, often in the phrase lab session
senses.definitionCN: 学生学习实际操作的教学时段，常作 lab session
senses.example: We have a physics lab on Thursday mornings.
senses.exampleCN: 我们周四上午有物理实验课。
senses.why: Students name the timetabled session after the room where it happens, a common shift in schools.
senses.whyCN: 学生用上课的房间来命名那节课，这在校园里是常见的转指。

senses.title: A place for testing ideas
senses.definition: a setting, often outside science, where new ideas are tried out
senses.definitionCN: 常不限于科学、用于试验新想法的场所或环境
senses.example: The city became a lab for new transport schemes.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市成了新交通方案的试验场。
senses.why: A lab is a place built for testing, so any situation used to try things out borrows its name.
senses.whyCN: 实验室是为检验而设的地方，因此任何用来试新事的情境都借用它的名字。

intro.en: Lab is a shortened form of laboratory, and it became a word in its own right only in the twentieth century.
intro.cn: lab 是 laboratory 的缩略形式，作为独立词通行是二十世纪的事。

items.en: The Latin verb laborare meant to work, and laboratorium named a place for work.
items.cn: 拉丁语动词 laborare 意为「工作」，laboratorium 指干活的地方。

items.en: In alchemy the laboratorium was the room where heating and distillation were done.
items.cn: 炼金术里 laboratorium 是做加热与蒸馏的房间。

items.en: English borrowed laboratory in the seventeenth century for rooms where scientific work was done.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪借入 laboratory，指做科学工作的房间。

items.en: The clipping lab appears in the late nineteenth century, and students and colleagues spread it.
items.cn: 缩略形式 lab 出现于十九世纪晚期，由学生与同行传开。

items.en: In the twentieth century lab also names the practical class and any place where ideas are tested.
items.cn: 二十世纪时 lab 也指实验课，以及任何试验新想法的场所。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short words close in spelling; the near-meaning group gathers other places for scientific or practical work.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写接近的短词；近义组收其他科学或实践场所。

entries.definition: The full word from which lab is cut, and the more formal choice on signs.
entries.definitionCN: lab 所缩略的完整词，标牌上更正式的用字。

entries.definition: Shares the Latin work root, and means physical work or workers.
entries.definitionCN: 与之共享拉丁语「劳动」词根，指体力劳动或劳工。

entries.definition: Two letters apart, and names a rounded part of an organ.
entries.definitionCN: 差两个字母，指器官上圆钝的一部分。

entries.definition: A room with tools for making or repairing things.
entries.definitionCN: 放着工具、用来制作或修理的房间。

entries.definition: A room where an artist or a broadcaster works.
entries.definitionCN: 艺术家或播音人员工作的房间。

entries.definition: A place where patients are examined and treated.
entries.definitionCN: 检查与治疗病人的场所。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin work root, the clipping history and the collocations the word now has.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语「劳动」词根、缩略历史，以及如今的常见搭配。

normal.en: Lab is laboratory cut short, the way phone is telephone cut short.
normal.cn: lab 是 laboratory 的截短，正如 phone 是 telephone 的截短。

normal.en: Laboratory comes from Latin laborare, to work, so a lab is a workroom.
normal.cn: laboratory 出自拉丁语 laborare（工作），所以实验室就是干活的屋子。

normal.en: Lab work and lab report are the two phrases students meet first.
normal.cn: lab work 与 lab report 是学生最先遇到的两个搭配。

normal.en: A language lab teaches speech with recordings, not chemistry.
normal.cn: language lab 用录音教人说话，与化学无关。

normal.en: The plural is plain labs, with no extra change.
normal.cn: 复数是简单的 labs，没有别的变化。

abstract.en: A lab is a room built for questions: every instrument exists to take one doubt out of the world.
abstract.cn: 实验室是为问题而建的房间：每件仪器都是为消除一个疑虑而存在。

abstract.en: The word is short because work in such rooms is quick, repeated and spoken about every day.
abstract.cn: 这个词短，是因为这类房间里的工作迅速、重复、天天要提。

abstract.en: Once a lab meant a place for alchemy, now any city can be a lab for testing change.
abstract.cn: 曾经实验室是炼金之处，如今任何一座城市都可以成为试验变革的实验室。

examples.en: The water samples were tested in the lab.
examples.cn: 水样在实验室里做了检测。

examples.en: We have a chemistry lab every Tuesday.
examples.cn: 我们每周二有一次化学实验课。

examples.en: The old factory became a lab for new designs.
examples.cn: 那座旧工厂成了新设计的试验场。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「来百」——来上百次实验，才得一个结果

root: 拉丁语 laborare「工作」的派生名词 laboratorium（干活之所），炼金术时代指加热致馏的房间；十七世纪英语借入 laboratory，十九世纪晚期缩略为 lab，二十世纪扩展到实验课与试验场。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: the room with instruments, the practical class held there, and any place where ideas are tried out.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：放仪器的房间，在那里上的实验课，以及任何试验新想法的地方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bench of white tiles with glassware, lamps and a notebook waiting.
core.cn: 核心意象：白瓷砖台面上摆着玻璃器皿、灯和一本待写的笔记。

branches.en: THE ROOM LINE: a space fitted out for experiment and test.
branches.cn: 房间线：为实验与检测而装配的空间。

branches.en: THE CLASS LINE: the timetabled session takes the name of the room.
branches.cn: 课程线：排定的课时借用了房间之名。

branches.en: THE METAPHOR LINE: any setting used to try new ideas becomes a lab.
branches.cn: 比喻线：任何试验新想法的情境都成了实验室。

branches.en: THE WORK LINE: the Latin root laborare makes a lab a place of work.
branches.cn: 劳动线：拉丁词根 laborare 让实验室成为干活之地。

branches.en: THE FORM LINE: a clipped word travels fast into general speech.
branches.cn: 形式线：截短的词很快走进日常语言。

intro.en: Lab is a clipping; its family is built from the full laboratory and from modern compounds.
intro.cn: lab 是截短词，其词族由完整的 laboratory 与现代合成构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin work root behind laboratory is recorded in labor and laborare.
latinIntro.cn: laboratory 背后的拉丁语「劳动」词根在 labor 与 laborare 中都有记录。

items.example: The new labs open in May.
The laboratory is on floor two.
It forms laboratory and factory-like words.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 laboratory 一类表示场所的词。

items.example: He put on a clean lab coat.
The language lab has forty seats.

items.meaningCN: 构成 lab work（实验工作）
items.example: Lab work counts for half the mark.

definition_zh: 标签；标记；称号；贴标签；把……称为
definition_en: a small piece of paper or cloth giving information about something, a word used to describe a person or group, or to fix such a tag on something
core_image: 一只玻璃罐上贴着一方白纸，写着内容与日期
scene: 厨房的架子上摆满一排玻璃罐，里面装着不同颜色的粉。She wrote the date on a label and stuck it to the jar of flour.
sceneCN: 这里 label 是「标签」（第 1 个义项：提供信息的小纸片或布片），句意是她在标签上写了日期，贴在面粉罐上。画面里有厨房架子、一排玻璃罐与一方白纸。

pos.zh: 名词：标签；标记；称号
动词：贴标签于；把……称为

derivatives.zh: 加 -ed 构成，义为「贴有标签的；被称作的」
加 -ing 构成，义为「贴标签；标签说明」
植物学术语，由本词派生，义为「有唇瓣的」

senses.title: A tag giving information
senses.definition: a small piece of paper, cloth, or plastic fixed to an object to show what it is, who made it, or what it contains
senses.definitionCN: 贴在物件上、说明其名称、制作者或成分的小纸片、布片或塑片
senses.example: The washing label says to use cold water.
senses.exampleCN: 洗标上写着要用冷水洗。
senses.why: The core object is a small carrier of written information attached to something bigger.
senses.whyCN: 核心物件是一小块信息的载体，附着在更大的物体上。

senses.title: A word used to classify someone
senses.definition: a short word or phrase used to describe a person, a group, or a style, often too simply
senses.definitionCN: 用来描述某人、某群体或某种风格的简短词语，常失之简单
senses.example: She dislikes the label of a protest singer.
senses.exampleCN: 她不喜欢「抗议歌手」这个标签。
senses.why: Once the written tag is put on an object, the same gesture is done to people with a word, and the metaphor is fixed.
senses.whyCN: 文字标签既可贴物，同样的动作也可以用词贴人，这个比喻便固定下来。

senses.title: To fix a tag on something
senses.definition: to attach a label to an object, or to write information on it
senses.definitionCN: 给物件贴标签，或在上面写明信息
senses.example: All the boxes must be labelled before shipping.
senses.exampleCN: 所有箱子在发运前都必须贴好标签。
senses.why: The noun of a tag becomes the verb of attaching one, as English commonly does with objects.
senses.whyCN: 标签这一物件名词转为「贴上标签」的动词，英语中这类器物转动词很常见。

senses.title: To describe or brand
senses.definition: to describe a person or thing with a particular word, often unfairly
senses.definitionCN: 用某个词描述某人或某物，常带不公意味
senses.example: The paper labelled the plan a waste of money.
senses.exampleCN: 报纸把这项计划称作浪费钱。
senses.why: The verb repeats on people what the noun does to jars: a word is stuck on and then treated as the truth.
senses.whyCN: 动词把名词对罐子所做的事用到人身上：把一个词贴上去，随后当作事实。

senses.title: A brand name on goods
senses.definition: the name of a company or designer shown on a product, especially in fashion
senses.definitionCN: 商品上显示的公司或设计师名称，尤见于时装
senses.example: He refuses to pay extra for a designer label.
senses.exampleCN: 他拒绝为名牌标识多付钱。
senses.why: In fashion the maker name became the thing itself, so a label on the collar can double the price.
senses.whyCN: 在时装业里制作者之名成了东西本身，于是领口上一个标签就能让价格翻倍。

intro.en: Label comes from an Old French word for a rag or ribbon, and its meaning moved from the strip to the information written on it.
intro.cn: label 源自古法语中表示「布条、丝带」的词，词义由那条带子转到写在带子上的信息。

items.en: A Germanic root meaning to hang down or to flap lies behind the French word.
items.cn: 法语这个词的背后，是一个表示「垂下、飘动」的日耳曼语词根。

items.en: Label meant a narrow strip or ribbon hanging loose, often attached to a seal or a garment.
items.cn: label 指垂着的一条窄带或丝带，常系在印章或衣物上。

items.en: English borrowed it for the paper strip that carried a name or an address.
items.cn: 英语借它指写着名字或地址的纸条。

items.en: The strip and its writing merged, so label came to mean the written information itself.
items.cn: 带子与上面的文字合为一体，label 遂指文字信息本身。

items.en: The word turns into a metaphor and a verb: people are labelled, and brands are labels.
items.cn: 这个词转为比喻与动词：人被贴标签，品牌也被称作 label。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers derived forms and close spellings; the near-meaning group gathers other words for tags and names.
note.cn: 形近组收派生形式与相近拼写；近义组收其他表示标签与名称的词。

entries.definition: The past form and adjective, spelled with one l in American English.
entries.definitionCN: 过去式与形容词，美式英语只写一个 l。

entries.definition: A common wrong spelling, with the two letters swapped.
entries.definitionCN: 常见错拼，两个字母颠倒了。

entries.definition: One letter away, and it means a published false statement that harms someone.
entries.definitionCN: 只差一个字母，指发表出来损害他人的不实之词。

entries.definition: A small movable card or plastic piece attached to show price or owner.
entries.definitionCN: 附于物件、显示价格或主人的可移动小牌。

entries.definition: A gummed piece of paper stuck on a surface.
entries.definitionCN: 贴在表面的带胶纸片。

entries.definition: The name of a product or company, or a mark made by burning.
entries.definitionCN: 产品或公司的名称，也可指烙印。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the rag origin of the word, the British and American spellings, and the phrases it appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用这个词「布条」的来源、英美两种拼写，以及常见搭配。

normal.en: Label once meant a hanging strip of cloth, and now it means what is written on it.
normal.cn: label 原是垂着的一条布，如今指写在布上的字。

normal.en: British English doubles the l: labelled, labelling.
normal.cn: 英式英语双写 l：labelled、labelling。

normal.en: Read the label before you wash the shirt.
normal.cn: 洗衬衫之前先看标签。

normal.en: To label someone is to stick a word on them and walk away.
normal.cn: 给某人贴标签，就是把一个词贴在他身上然后走开。

normal.en: A designer label costs more for the name than for the cloth.
normal.cn: 名牌标识贵的是名字，而非布料。

abstract.en: A label is a promise of order: one small paper, and a whole shelf becomes readable.
abstract.cn: 标签是秩序的一份承诺：一小片纸，整排架子便读得懂。

abstract.en: The same act that helps a jar be found can make a person be misunderstood.
abstract.cn: 帮人找到罐子的同一动作，也能让人被误解。

abstract.en: What is written on the outside is not the thing inside, a difference worth keeping in mind whenever a label is read.
abstract.cn: 外面写的并非里面之物，每次看标签时都值得记住这个差别。

examples.en: Check the label for the ingredients.
examples.cn: 查看标签上的成分表。

examples.en: Every file was labelled with a date.
examples.cn: 每个文件都标上了日期。

examples.en: It is unfair to label him a trouble-maker.
examples.cn: 称他为麻烦制造者是不公平的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「累抱」——抱着罐子累了一路，就为看清那方标签

root: 古法语 label「垂着的布条、丝带」，背后是表示「垂下」的日耳曼语词根；中古英语借入指写有姓名地址的纸条，后由带子转为上面所写的信息，并引申出「称号」与「贴标签、把……称为」等义。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: the information tag, the word used of a person, the act of tagging, the act of branding someone with a word, and the brand name on goods.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：信息标签，用于人的称号，贴标签的动作，用词给人定性，以及商品上的品牌标识。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a square of white paper on a jar, with a name and a date in ink.
core.cn: 核心意象：玻璃罐上一方白纸，墨写着名称与日期。

branches.en: THE TAG LINE: a small carrier of written information attached to a thing.
branches.cn: 标签线：附着在物件上、承载文字信息的小片。

branches.en: THE WORD LINE: a short word stuck on a person, a style or a garment.
branches.cn: 词语线：贴在人、风格或衣物上的简短说法。

branches.en: THE ACTION LINE: the verb fixes a tag on an object.
branches.cn: 动作线：动词给物件贴上标签。

branches.en: THE JUDGEMENT LINE: the same act with words can be unfair.
branches.cn: 判断线：用词做同样的事，可能不公。

branches.en: THE FORM LINE: object and action share one form, as English often allows.
branches.cn: 形式线：物件与动作共用一个形式，英语常这样。

intro.en: Label is a French loan whose family grows through spelling variants and ordinary suffixes.
intro.cn: label 是法语借词，其词族靠拼写变体与普通后缀扩展。

latinIntro.en: Label is not Latin in origin, though the French form goes back to a Germanic strip.
latinIntro.cn: label 并非源自拉丁语，其法语形式可上溯到日耳曼语中「布条」一词。

definition_zh: 实验室；实验楼；研究室；实验课
definition_en: a room or building equipped for scientific experiments, research, and testing, or the work carried on in it
core_image: 一整层楼里都摆着长台，仪器在灯下泛出冷光
scene: 实验楼的门牌是不锈钢的，走廊里能听到通风柜低低的嗡声。The whole laboratory was working on a single problem that winter.
sceneCN: 这里 laboratory 是「实验室」（第 1 个义项：配备设备进行科学实验与研究的场所），句意是那个冬天整个实验室都在攻克同一个问题。画面里有不锈钢门牌、走廊与通风柜的嗡声。

pos.zh: 名词：实验室；实验室工作；研究室

derivatives.zh: laboratory 的缩略形式，义为「实验室」
由本词派生，义为「实验室工作人员」
由本词派生，义为「实验室的」

senses.title: A room equipped for experiments
senses.definition: a room fitted with instruments and apparatus for scientific experiments and tests
senses.definitionCN: 配有仪器设备、用于科学实验与检测的房间
senses.example: The laboratory was closed while the equipment was replaced.
senses.exampleCN: 设备更换期间实验室关闭了。
senses.why: The word names a place built for work, and in science that work is experiment.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指为工作而建的场所，在科学里那项工作就是实验。

senses.title: A building or department for research
senses.definition: a whole building or a research unit where scientific work is carried out
senses.definitionCN: 开展科学工作的整栋建筑或一个研究单位
senses.example: He has worked at the national laboratory for twenty years.
senses.exampleCN: 他在国家实验室工作了二十年。
senses.why: One equipped room became the seed of a whole institution, so the place name grew to a building or a research unit.
senses.whyCN: 一间配好设备的房间成了一整个机构的种子，于是这个词从房间扩大到建筑或研究单位。

senses.title: The work done there
senses.definition: the practical scientific work itself, often in phrases such as laboratory practice
senses.definitionCN: 实验工作本身，常见于 laboratory practice 一类说法
senses.example: Good laboratory practice keeps results reliable.
senses.exampleCN: 良好的实验操作规范让结果可靠。
senses.why: The place names its own activity, the way a school can stand for schooling.
senses.whyCN: 场所为其自身的活动命名，正如学校可以代表教育本身。

intro.en: Laboratory is a Medieval Latin place noun from the verb to work, and it was used in alchemy before it reached science.
intro.cn: laboratory 是源自「工作」动词的中世纪拉丁语场所名词，先用于炼金术，后进入科学。

items.en: The verb laborare meant to work or toil, and labor meant toil itself.
items.cn: 动词 laborare 意为「工作、劳作」，labor 即劳累本身。

items.en: Laboratorium named a place for work, and alchemists used it for rooms of furnaces and stills.
items.cn: laboratorium 指工作之所，炼金术士用它称呼摆满炉与蒸馏器的房间。

items.en: English borrows laboratory in the seventeenth century for rooms of chemical and physical work.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语借入 laboratory，指做化学与物理工作的房间。

items.en: British speech shortens it to lab, and American use puts the stress on the first syllable.
items.cn: 英式口语把它缩为 lab，美式则把重音放在第一音节。

items.en: In the twentieth century the word spreads from chemistry to psychology, language study and industry.
items.cn: 二十世纪里这个词从化学扩展到心理学、语言教学与工业。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words sharing the Latin work root and forms of this word; the near-meaning group gathers other places of study and work.
note.cn: 形近组收共享拉丁语「劳动」词根的词与本词的形式；近义组收其他学习与工作场所。

entries.definition: The everyday clipping of laboratory.
entries.definitionCN: laboratory 的日常缩略形式。

entries.definition: The Latin work root in its other English form, meaning toil or workers.
entries.definitionCN: 同一拉丁语词根的另一英语形式，指劳作或劳工。

entries.definition: Built on the same work root, meaning worked out in great detail.
entries.definitionCN: 同出该词根，义为「精心制作的」。

entries.definition: A room with tools for making, not for controlled experiment.
entries.definitionCN: 放工具做制作的房间，不是做受控实验的。

entries.definition: A place built to watch the sky, named after looking rather than working.
entries.definitionCN: 为观测天空而建的地方，以「看」而非「做」命名。

entries.definition: An organisation for research or teaching, larger than one room.
entries.definitionCN: 研究或教学机构，规模大于一个房间。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin root, the British and American stress, and the phrases the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语词根、英美重音差别，以及这个词常见的搭配。

normal.en: Laboratory is built on laborare, to work, so it is a room for work.
normal.cn: laboratory 建立在 laborare（工作）之上，所以是为了干活而设的屋子。

normal.en: Alchemists had laboratories before scientists did.
normal.cn: 炼金术士比科学家更早拥有实验室。

normal.en: British speakers say it with four beats, American speakers with three.
normal.cn: 英式读音是四个音节，美式是三个。

normal.en: Laboratory equipment and laboratory test are the standard pairings.
normal.cn: laboratory equipment 与 laboratory test 是标准搭配。

normal.en: The lab is the same word with the middle taken out.
normal.cn: lab 就是这个词挖掉中间的那一截。

abstract.en: A laboratory is a place where the world is made small enough to question.
abstract.cn: 实验室是把世界缩小到可以被追问的地方。

abstract.en: The name means only workroom, yet the work inside keeps turning guesses into evidence.
abstract.cn: 它的名字只意味着「工作间」，里面的事却不断把猜测变成证据。

abstract.en: Any place built to test a claim, from a clinic to a city, now borrows this name.
abstract.cn: 任何为检验主张而建的地方，从诊所到城市，如今都借用这个名字。

examples.en: The samples are analysed in a licensed laboratory.
examples.cn: 样本在具备资质的实验室里分析。

examples.en: The laboratory moved into a larger building last year.
examples.cn: 这个实验室去年搬进了更大的楼里。

examples.en: Laboratory work takes a third of the course.
examples.cn: 实验工作占这门课程的三分之一。

dict_mnemonic.text: labor 劳动 + -atory 场所——干活的地方，就是实验室

root: 拉丁语 laborare（工作、劳作）派生名词 laboratorium（干活之所），中世纪拉丁语中用于炼金术的工作室；十七世纪英语借入，指科学实验场所，后缩略为 lab，并扩展至心理学、语言教学与工业研究。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: the equipped room, the building or research unit it grew into, and the practical work carried on there.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：配备仪器的房间，由它扩展而成的整栋建筑或研究单位，以及在那里进行的实验工作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: long benches under cold lights, instruments waiting to be used.
core.cn: 核心意象：冷白灯光下的长台，仪器等着被使用。

branches.en: THE ROOM LINE: a space fitted with apparatus for tests.
branches.cn: 房间线：为检测而装设仪器的空间。

branches.en: THE BUILDING LINE: the name grows to a whole research unit.
branches.cn: 建筑线：名字可扩展到整个研究单位。

branches.en: THE ACTIVITY LINE: the place stands for the work done in it.
branches.cn: 活动线：场所代表在其中所做的工作。

branches.en: THE ROOT LINE: laborare makes the word a workroom by origin.
branches.cn: 词根线：laborare 让这个词在原义上就是工作间。

branches.en: THE SHORT LINE: the clipping lab is now the everyday form.
branches.cn: 简短线：缩略形式 lab 已成日常说法。

intro.en: Laboratory is a Latin place noun whose family in English is mainly the clipping, plus a few formal derivatives.
intro.cn: laboratory 是拉丁语场所名词，其英语词族主要是截短形式与少数正式派生词。

latinIntro.en: Latin labor, laborare, laboratorium and elaborare are all recorded, so nothing here is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 labor、laborare、laboratorium 与 elaborare 均有记录，故此无构拟成分。

items.example: The laboratory is quiet at night.
The noun is the source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是整族的源头。

items.example: It marks a laboratory for research.
items.exampleCN: 它标明用于研究的实验室。

latinEntries.meaning: to work out, to take pains
